```{r, results="hide", echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE)
if (!exists(".version")) {
    .version <- package_version("1.0")
}
```

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("# Simple list (", as.character(.version), ")", sep="")
```

## Overview

The `simple_list` specification describes the on-disk representation of a **simple list**.
This is based on an ordinary R list.

## Object metadata

The `OBJECT` file should contain a `simple_list` property, itself a JSON object with the following properties:

- `version`, a string specifying the version of the `simple_list` format.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("  This should be set to \"", as.character(.version), "\".", sep="")
```
- (optional) `format`, a string specifying the format to use.
  This should be one of `"hdf5"` or `"json.gz"`.
  If not provided, it is assumed to be `"hdf5"`.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
if (.version >= package_version("1.1")) {
    cat("- (optional) `length`, a non-negative integer specifying the length of the **simple list**.
This property is provided as a convenience for JSON-formatted files, so that readers do not need to parse the entire file to determine the list length.")
}
```

## Directory structure

### Contents

The directory should contain:

- `OBJECT`, a JSON file as described above.

If `format = "hdf5"`, the directory should also contain:

- `list_contents.h5`, a HDF5 file.

If `format = "json.gz"`, the directory should instead contain:

- `list_contents.json.gz`, a Gzip-compressed JSON file.

Optionally, the directory may contain:

- `other_contents/`, a subdirectory.

### `list_contents.h5`

The `list_contents.h5` file should follow the [**uzuki2**](https://github.com/ArtifactDB/uzuki2) HDF5 specification for R lists.

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
blah <- "The top-level object should be an R list."
if (.version >= package_version("1.1")) {
    blah <- paste(blah, "If the `simple_list/length` property is present in the object metadata, this should be equal to the length of the R list (see the [\"Height\"](#height) section below).")
}
blah <- paste(blah, "", "The R list may contain any number of external objects referencing a subdirectory in [`other_contents/`](#other-contents).") 
cat(blah)
```

### `list_contents.json.gz`

The `list_contents.json.gz` file should be a Gzip-compressed file that follows the [**uzuki2**](https://github.com/ArtifactDB/uzuki2) JSON specification for R lists.

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(blah)
```

### `other_contents/`

The `other_contents/` subdirectory contains any number of subdirectories.

Each subdirectory in `other_contents/` contains a child object that is referenced by an external object inside the R list in the `list_contents.h5` or `list_contents.json.gz` file.
Each subdirectory is named after the index used to refer to it, e.g., `other_contents/{x}/` is referenced by an external object with an index of $x$.
See the [**uzuki2** documentation](https://github.com/ArtifactDB/uzuki2) for more details on external objects.

Aside from the subdirectories corresponding to external objects, no other files or directories should be present in the `other_contents/` subdirectory.
The exception is that of files/directories prefixed with `.` or `_`, which are ignored.

## Height

The height of the **simple list** is defined as the length of the R list in `list_contents.h5` or `list_contents.json.gz`.
The length of the R list is equal to its number of elements, without any consideration for the size/shape of nested lists or other objects in each element.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
if (.version >= package_version("1.1")) {
    cat("The length can also be taken from the `simple_list/length` property of the object metadata, if available.")
}
```

## Interfaces

The **simple list** satisfies the `SIMPLE_LIST` interface.
